remarks: Prepare to be captivated with this 4 bedroom home located in desirable mid-city. This sunny and bright home offers the space, layout and features you want for how we live today. The stunning eat-in-kitchen with quartz counters, breakfast bar and sweeping views of the private backyard and river will take your breath away. You'll forget you're in Stamford and think you're in the country when listening to the sounds of the river at the edge of the backyard. Hosting holidays is a dream with the excellent flow from living room and dining room. And sought after first floor bedroom (currently used as a home office) enhances this special property. A renovated full bath complete the first floor. Upstairs the oversized primary bedroom, 2 additional bedrooms and renovated full bath with skylight add to the perfection. Need additional living space for family room, playroom or gym? The finished lower level can accomodate these needs. 1 car garage, pretty plantings and enlarged driveway make this home a winner. Close to everything downtown Stamford has to offer: entertainment, restaurants, shopping and Metro North. This home you thought only existed in your dreams is right here. Unpack and move right in!
